title: Australia Declared War on Birds. The Birds Won.
hook: Australia once sent *machine guns* after birds, and *lost*.
lines: In 1932, twenty thousand *emus* were flattening wheat farms in Western Australia.
So the army sent Major Meredith, two soldiers, and two *Lewis guns*.
The emus split into tiny groups and *scattered* the second shooting started.
One ambush ended with a *jammed gun* and twelve dead emus.
They even mounted a gun on a truck. The emus simply *outran it*.
Meredith said they faced machine guns like *tanks*.
After nearly ten thousand rounds, the army *pulled out*.
loop_line: So next time someone says humans *rule this planet*, just remind them:
description: The Great Emu War of 1932, when the Australian army took on twenty thousand emus and retreated.
